goal.text: Clear and reset the living area before guests arrive, keeping track of where everything that was moved has ended up.

turns.text: Keep track of what I shift, would you?

trigger.detail: wearer opens the session while tidying the living area

expected_answer.text: Got it. I'm following along, so ask whenever you want to know what you moved or where it ended up.

turns.text: - so did the plant go down before I grabbed these, or after?

trigger.detail: plant set down on the table, pillows lifted off the seating

expected_answer.text: Before. You set the small potted plant on the glass table with both hands, straightened up, and only then leaned over to lift the pillows.

turns.text: And the bottle after — which hand took it?

trigger.detail: bottle lifted from the centre table and carried across the room

expected_answer.text: Your left. You picked the bottle up left-handed, carried it across, and set it down on the side table by the window.

turns.text: hold on - did I leave anything on the glass one, or is it clear now?

trigger.detail: wearer stops mid-room and looks back down at the cleared surface

expected_answer.text: Not clear. The hangers are still lying on it - that's the only thing left there now that the bottle's gone.

turns.text: Back to those hangers. Which hand slid that door open?

trigger.detail: hangers hung inside the hallway closet, wearer turns back

expected_answer.text: Your left hand slid it open while your right kept hold of the hangers, and then you hung them inside right-handed before turning back.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm - actually, where did the rubbish from that table end up?

trigger.detail: backchannel turns into a question as the wearer reaches the bin

expected_answer.text: In the kitchen bin. You carried the plastic pack and carton over, popped the lid with your right foot, and dropped them in left-handed.

turns.text: How many trips did that take me?

trigger.detail: wearer back in the living area, bin run finished

expected_answer.text: One. You gathered everything off that table in a single armful and took it straight over, then came back empty-handed.

turns.text: Okay - and this one, where was it sitting before I picked it up?

trigger.detail: wearer lifts the seat with both hands and turns with it

expected_answer.text: It was over by the railing on your right. You've just carried it across and set it down facing the table you cleared earlier.

turns.text: Second one now. Have I moved both, or just the one?

trigger.detail: wearer crouches at the far seat and starts dragging it

expected_answer.text: Both, nearly. The first is already in place; this second one you've only dragged back a step so far, it isn't squared up yet.

turns.text: actually - remind me where I put the drink, I've lost track.

trigger.detail: wearer cuts in with an unrelated recall request

expected_answer.text: On the side table by the window - you moved it there early on, left-handed, and it hasn't been touched since.

turns.text: Okay, what came out from underneath just now?

trigger.detail: wearer pulls a box out from under the low table and sets it down

expected_answer.text: The games box - you pulled it out left-handed from under the table, and the book you'd lifted off the top went down on the floor beside it.

turns.text: I glanced away — what caught my eye?

trigger.detail: gaze left the sweeping area and settled on the stairs

expected_answer.text: The stairs. You looked up from the brush towards them for a couple of seconds, then went straight back to sweeping.

turns.text: oh, before I forget - the cushions. Did they all land on the same seat?

trigger.detail: wearer cuts in with a callback to the start of the tidy-up

expected_answer.text: No. Two went onto the long sofa, one from each hand, and the third you swapped across and dropped on the single-seater.

turns.text: Perfect, that's the lot then - I'll call it done.

trigger.detail: sweeping winding down, wearer closes out the task

expected_answer.text: Agreed, the room's clear and the floor's nearly done; nothing you moved is still unaccounted for.
